targetText: These machines, which were very expensive and hence could be bought only by big capitalists, altered the whole mode of production and displaced the former workers
explanation: Technological automation under private ownership drives capital concentration, displacing independent artisans and creating a polarized society of big capitalists and propertyless wage earners.
summary: Technological automation under private ownership concentrates production into the hands of big capitalists while displacing artisans into the wage-earning proletariat.
